messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or external services, so I can’t tell you the exact current local time in New York City right now.

If you’d like an up‑to‑the‑minute timestamp, you could check:

* A trusted world‑clock website (e.g., https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york)
* Your phone’s built‑in world‑clock feature
* Any online “current time” service that shows UTC offset (+/-) for Eastern Time (UTC−5 during standard time, UTC−4 when daylight saving is active)

Those sources will give you the precise moment in New York at your request.
message.reasoning: User asks current time in NYC. We need real-time data; we can't fetch live info. According to policy, cannot provide inaccurate or guess. Should respond with limitation. Possibly suggest using reliable source like world clock. So answer explaining inability.
